title: Signing up for a language course
instructions: Bir adam İspanyolca kursuna yazılıyor. Seviye, gün, süre ve fiyatı takip et.

script.speaker: b
script.text: Hi. I'd like to join a Spanish course.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Great. Have you studied Spanish before?

script.speaker: b
script.text: A little, at school, but I've forgotten most of it.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Then the beginner course is best. It's on Monday and Wednesday evenings, from seven to nine.

script.speaker: b
script.text: I play football on Wednesdays. Is there another day?

script.speaker: a
script.text: Yes, Saturday mornings from ten to one.

script.speaker: b
script.text: That's better. How long is the course?

script.speaker: a
script.text: Twelve weeks, and it costs two hundred and forty pounds.

questions.prompt: Which course is best for Tom?
questions.feedback: Çoğunu unuttuğu için başlangıç kursu en iyisi.
questions.evidence: Then the beginner course is best.

questions.prompt: Why can't Tom go on Wednesdays?
When will Tom have his classes?
questions.evidence: Saturday mornings from ten to one.
